create_SoftActorCritic: create a SoftActorCritic policy learner with discrete action space and entropy autotuning enabled
learn_batch_SoftActorCritic: train the SoftActorCritic model on a batch of transitions and return actor critic loss
compute_critic_loss_SoftActorCritic: compute the twin critic action value loss using clipped double Q-learning for a transition batch
compute_actor_loss_SoftActorCritic: compute the actor policy loss with entropy regularization and clipped double Q-learning for a batch
compare_SoftActorCritic: compare two SoftActorCritic instances and return a string describing differences in entropy settings
